title: Discover older subject-owned session records in resumable erasure pages
scope: Bounded scan-first local erasure of older tenant session records owned by selected/base/current-linked subjects, beyond user pointers and remembered own sessions, including pointer-captured canonical sessions absent from the base.
non_goals: No transactional KV snapshot, new index/service, cross-store deletion epoch, approved D03/D06 policy, previous-account-only or forward-target ownership, D1/telemetry/log/external erasure or full W06/finding/customer/gate/release/SLO acceptance.

Preserve exact pending v1/v2/v3 plans/cursors and protected dirty worktree. No serving/scoring changes, broad suite/new harness, deploy/cloud/credentials/customer data/commit/push/destructive operation or subdelegation.

criteria.description: Fresh v4 recognized/anonymous erasure finds older session records by actual userId plus frozen base/current-link ownership witnesses, across bounded tenant pages saved before deletion. Old canonical/base-visitor/current extra sessions are erased; other tenants/owners and previous-account-only records remain. Pointer-captured canonical sessions omitted from session listing are still cleaned. Do not follow forwardTo, identity or anonymousId as ownership.

At most one32-key identity page and one32-key session page per call; bounded saved session capsules and shared32 attempted cleanup steps. Recover page/root/step/compaction ambiguity without relisting saved observations, retain actor/cutoff, validate malformed/foreign/nonprogressing state and exact owner/session witnesses. Exact pending v1/v2/v3 numeric plans remain; honest session-only batch/cumulative receipts and raw child compaction.

Independent final actual-source/admission-diff/manifest and complete worker proof review, exact K1 once; inspect compiler/scoped whitespace without rerun. Verify C1-C2 side effects and explicit visibility/concurrency/retention/performance/destination limits; reuse valid unchanged dependency inspection without old-task closure.

checks.runtime: Installed Node/Vitest with actual identity route, erasure, SessionManager and existing synthetic KV/R2/DO seams; no network.
checks.workload: One existing identity fixture: older owned sessions beyond pointers, nondefault tenant isolation/current ownership, bounded scan-before-delete, retry/corruption/compaction and exact legacy plans; worker app noEmit and scoped whitespace.

dependencies.rationale: Extend fresh jobs while preserving old schemas/cursors. New task checks changed behavior; does not reaccept historical whole-task proof.
Paging and root CAS are not a KV snapshot or concurrent erasure fence.

handoff.next_action: Implement approved W06.09 v4 bounded session discovery in erase.ts and existing route fixture, then focused worker checks and independent frozen review. Root alone records acceptance.
